text: Don't you ever, ever sleep with your phone. Put it in another room. And the reason is not what you think. I am not going to talk about how it interrupts your sleep. I want to talk about what happens when you wake. The alarm rings. You reach for it.

You are not even upright yet. And already you have invited the whole world into your bedroom. The news. The messages. A thousand strangers. Before your feet touch the ground, your mind is already running.

And then we wonder why the day feels heavy before it begins. The first minutes of the morning are the most receptive of your whole day. Whatever enters first will set the tone for everything after. Protect them.

Let the morning belong to you before it belongs to the world. Moving the phone clears the doorway. It does not quiet the mind that reaches for it. That quiet is built, and I spent forty years learning how.
Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
